description.zh-CN: 患者健康问卷第 9 版（PHQ-9），国际上广泛使用的抑郁症状筛查量表，询问过去两周内 9 种常见症状出现的频率。
description.en: The Patient Health Questionnaire-9, a widely used screener that asks how often nine common depressive symptoms occurred over the last two weeks.

instructions.zh-CN: 在过去的两周里，你生活中以下症状出现的频率有多少？
instructions.en: Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you been bothered by any of the following problems?

licenseNote.zh-CN: PHQ 系列量表由 Robert L. Spitzer、Janet B.W. Williams、Kurt Kroenke 等人在 Pfizer 教育资助下编制，属于公有领域，复制、翻译、展示和分发均无需许可（见 phqscreeners.com 使用手册）。
licenseNote.en: The PHQ measures were developed by Drs. Robert L. Spitzer, Janet B.W. Williams, Kurt Kroenke and colleagues with an educational grant from Pfizer Inc. They are in the public domain; no permission is required to reproduce, translate, display or distribute (PHQ instruction manual, phqscreeners.com).

source.zh-CN: Kroenke K, Spitzer RL, Williams JBW. The PHQ-9: validity of a brief depression severity measure. J Gen Intern Med 2001;16:606-613。分级依据官方使用手册。中文措辞采用国内研究中广泛使用的简体中文版本，尚未与 phqscreeners.com 的官方中文译本逐字核对。
source.en: Kroenke K, Spitzer RL, Williams JBW. The PHQ-9: validity of a brief depression severity measure. J Gen Intern Med 2001;16:606-613. Severity bands follow the official instruction manual.

citation: Kroenke K, Spitzer RL, Williams JBW. The PHQ-9: validity of a brief depression severity measure. J Gen Intern Med. 2001;16(9):606-613.

text.zh-CN: 做事时提不起劲或没有兴趣
text.en: Little interest or pleasure in doing things

text.zh-CN: 感到心情低落、沮丧或绝望
入睡困难、睡不安稳或睡眠过多
text.en: Trouble falling or staying asleep, or sleeping too much
Feeling tired or having little energy

text.zh-CN: 觉得自己很糟，或觉得自己很失败，或让自己或家人失望
text.en: Feeling bad about yourself — or that you are a failure or have let yourself or your family down

text.zh-CN: 对事物专注有困难，例如阅读报纸或看电视时
text.en: Trouble concentrating on things, such as reading the newspaper or watching television

text.zh-CN: 动作或说话速度缓慢到别人已经觉察；或正好相反，烦躁或坐立不安、动来动去的情况比平常多
text.en: Moving or speaking so slowly that other people could have noticed? Or the opposite — being so fidgety or restless that you have been moving around a lot more than usual

text.zh-CN: 有不如死掉或用某种方式伤害自己的念头
text.en: Thoughts that you would be better off dead or of hurting yourself in some way

summary.zh-CN: 过去两周里，抑郁相关的症状很少或几乎没有。
summary.en: Few or no depressive symptoms over the last two weeks.

suggestions.zh-CN: 继续保持规律的作息、运动和与他人的联系。
suggestions.en: Keep up regular sleep, activity and contact with people you trust.

suggestions.zh-CN: 状态有变化时，可以过一段时间再做一次自评作比较。
suggestions.en: If things change, take this check-in again later to compare.

summary.zh-CN: 存在一些抑郁相关的症状，程度较轻。很多人在压力较大或经历变化时都会出现这种情况。
summary.en: Some depressive symptoms at a mild level — common during stressful periods or changes.

suggestions.zh-CN: 留意睡眠、饮食和活动量，尽量保持规律。
suggestions.en: Pay attention to sleep, eating and activity, and keep them regular.

suggestions.zh-CN: 安排一些让自己感到愉快或有成就感的小事。
suggestions.en: Plan small activities that bring enjoyment or a sense of achievement.

suggestions.zh-CN: 可以在两周左右后再做一次，观察变化（官方建议此阶段“观察并复查”）。
suggestions.en: Repeat the check-in in about two weeks to see how things change (the official guidance is watchful waiting and repeat screening).

summary.zh-CN: 抑郁相关的症状已经比较明显。官方手册把 10 分作为需要关注的“黄色信号”。
summary.en: Depressive symptoms are fairly noticeable. The official manual treats 10 or more as a “yellow flag” worth attention.

suggestions.zh-CN: 建议和医生、心理咨询师或其他专业人士聊一聊，获得进一步的评估。
suggestions.en: Consider talking with a doctor, counsellor or other professional for a proper assessment.

suggestions.zh-CN: 把感受告诉一位信任的人，不必独自承受。
suggestions.en: Share how you feel with someone you trust; you do not have to carry it alone.

suggestions.zh-CN: 尽量保持基本的作息和日常活动，哪怕只是很小的一步。
suggestions.en: Try to keep basic routines and daily activities, even in small steps.

summary.zh-CN: 抑郁相关的症状较多且较频繁，可能已经影响到生活和工作。官方手册把 15 分作为“红色信号”。
summary.en: Many frequent depressive symptoms that may be affecting daily life. The official manual treats 15 or more as a “red flag”.

suggestions.zh-CN: 建议尽快联系医院的精神心理科、心理门诊或专业咨询机构进行评估。
suggestions.en: Please contact a mental-health service, clinic or qualified professional for an assessment soon.

suggestions.zh-CN: 如果需要倾诉或不知道从哪里开始，可以拨打全国统一心理援助热线 12356。
suggestions.en: If you need someone to talk to or do not know where to start, call a mental-health helpline (in China: 12356).

suggestions.zh-CN: 请告诉身边信任的人你最近的状态。
suggestions.en: Let someone close to you know how you have been.

summary.zh-CN: 抑郁相关的症状很多且几乎每天出现。这是一个需要认真对待的信号，你值得得到专业的帮助。
summary.en: Many symptoms nearly every day. This deserves serious attention, and you deserve professional support.

suggestions.zh-CN: 请尽快寻求专业帮助：医院精神心理科、心理门诊，或拨打 12356 心理援助热线。
suggestions.en: Please seek professional help soon: a mental-health service or clinic, or a mental-health helpline (in China: 12356).

suggestions.zh-CN: 如果有伤害自己的想法或身处危险中，请立即拨打 110 或 120，或前往最近的医院急诊。
suggestions.en: If you have thoughts of harming yourself or are in danger, call emergency services or go to the nearest emergency department now.

suggestions.zh-CN: 请让一位信任的人陪在身边。
suggestions.en: Ask someone you trust to stay with you.
